item.question: What is geometric tempering in the context of sampling from probability distributions?
item.answer: Geometric tempering is a method used to sample from complex multimodal probability distributions by creating a sequence of intermediate distributions. These intermediate distributions are formed using the geometric mean between an easier proposal distribution and the target distribution, facilitating more efficient sampling.
